entities.summary: Janet Biehl is an American author, copyeditor, translator, and artist. She authored several books and articles associated with social ecology, the body of ideas developed and publicized by Murray Bookchin. Formerly an advocate of his antistatist political program, she broke with it publicly in 2011 and now identifies as a progressive Democrat. Janet Biehl was a scientists & inventors from United States (b. 1953-09-04). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
